facebookresearch_spinquant/eval_utils/gp.run_gptq_quantization: run GPTQ quantization on a transformer model using a dataloader to collect input statistics layer by layer

facebookresearch_spinquant/eval_utils/ro.test_QKRotationWrapper: test the QKRotationWrapper class to apply hadamard transform and quantize K-cache in attention layers
facebookresearch_spinquant/eval_utils/ro.refactor_rotate_model: refactor the rotate_model function to load optimized rotation matrices from a checkpoint path
facebookresearch_spinquant/eval_utils/ro.review_add_qk_rotation_wrapper: review the add_qk_rotation_wrapper_after_function_call_in_forward function to monkeypatch rotation into model forward pass
